images.view: Cinematic view with a centred composition: the main element of the scene is placed in the middle of the frame, large and filling most of the frame height, with nothing important near the left or right edges, and no person in the foreground.
images.site: In space, in high orbit above a lifeless grey rocky planet whose curved horizon crosses the bottom of the frame, with stars in the black sky.
images.mood: Art direction: realistic sci-fi concept art, tense and suspenseful mood, cold bluish light with strong contrast, deep shadows.
images.subject: In the middle of the frame, a pirate fleet of battered dark spacecraft with patchwork hulls of dark gunmetal and rust-brown scavenged plates and glowing orange-red engines, built for space and not shaped like boats: two heavy gunships in the lead and a swarm of small dart-shaped fighters around them, flies in attack formation straight toward the viewer and the planet below.
images.detail: Their orange-red engine glows streak behind them; no explosions yet, nothing has been fired.

images.subject: Seen from behind and above, a pirate fleet of battered dark spacecraft with patchwork hulls of dark gunmetal and rust-brown scavenged plates and glowing orange-red engines, built for space and not shaped like boats: two heavy gunships in the lead and a swarm of small dart-shaped fighters around them, descends in formation toward the curved grey planet in the lower part of the frame.
images.detail: On the planet's surface, the tiny lights of a colony glow on the night side; no explosions yet.

images.mood: Art direction: realistic sci-fi concept art, tense and suspenseful mood, cold bluish light with strong contrast, deep shadows.
images.subject: High in the darkening sky above a far-future colony of white domes and towers on a grey rocky plain, small pirate fighter spacecraft, each a single-seat fighter with an angular dart-shaped body, short swept wings and glowing orange-red engine nozzles, its dark hull patched with mismatched scavenged plates, appear as a menacing formation of dark silhouettes diving toward the colony, their engines glowing orange-red.
images.detail: In the foreground, seen from behind, a single colonist in a plain white and grey work suit stands with a bare head, no helmet at all, short dark hair visible, looking up at them; the colony's defense turrets turn toward the sky; nothing has been fired yet.
